$why: Skim of the Bourbaki documents that name Grothendieck (#50, priority 3): for each, the PDF pages where he appears and a few words of context in our words. Nothing is transcribed. Read on the facsimiles of archives-bourbaki.ahp-numerique.fr by Opus 5.5 agents on 2026-10-10, unchecked by a human. Intermediate: 8 of the 36 documents skimmed.

passages.context: listed as a « cobaye », spelled « Grotendieck »: his earliest appearance
joke: he accepts Claudine Serre's « existence theorem »; uses spectral sequences daily, « for hygiene »
variétés need categorical preliminaries to run « la machine de Grothendieck »; no plan decided before discussing his rédaction
engagement: the « Diplodocus des variétés », for June 1957
connexions (réd. 257): his remark on non-vector fibrations
« Plan proposé par Grothendieck »: Livre VII Homologie, Livre VIII topologie élémentaire (sheaves, H¹, Leray, coverings), Livre IX variétés; his plan for the sheaves chapter, to which Serre objects
spectral theory (réd. 230): cf. his São Paulo course
arrives late, lost on the way; the minutes' running jokes about him
the differential calculus and Lie chapters are to start from his rédactions on variétés (n° 270), judged a good base
engagement: continue the « Diplodocus »; the next congress takes its sequel; Séminaire talk on Grauert's ramified coverings

« Notes sur le Diplodocus Grothendieck des variétés » (n° 262, n° 270): fairly satisfied, decision deferred to ch. II; categorical preliminaries indispensable; too much algebraic geometry; detailed remarks
his four-page paper on vector measures, inserted in the minutes
a possible ch. X of Alg. comm. would absorb § 12.3 of his n° 270
a new Ens. ch. V « Catégories et Foncteurs »: he supplied the plan, Samuel writes it
papers on Fredholm theory and on algebraic structures in categories
the categories plan: universes, citing the « vieux papiers Grothendieck et Samuel »
his project to recast Algèbre V and VIII, to be read in March 1966 « avec un certain effroi »
Alg. comm.: the « loi-cadre de la dimension », for mid-1966
Séminaire: his talk on the Brauer group; « Les motifs » planned
Gödel classes or universes, to be rediscussed « en présence de Grothendieck »
plan of a ch. V § 3 « Théorèmes de Grothendieck » and an Annexe « Résultats de Grothendieck »
the annex: his α-integral maps, a notation table against his, the « résultat fondamental » (the Grothendieck inequality)
his expansion with Σ|aₙ| ≤ 3; positivity of the aₙ left open
§ 10 « Groupes et anneaux de Grothendieck » (May 1974): only the eponym
pencilled in, with question marks, for sheaf homology and a report on analytic ideals; to send his proof that two axioms of his paper are incompatible
Séminaire: Kawada–Tate (Grothendieck)
the sheaves chapter to follow « le papier Grothendieck »; his point of view and proof compared with Godement's
his paper on homological algebra (n° 222) read « with enthusiasm »; Schwartz: generalise it a little
